# Know which authorizations run out, which expire unused, and when to reauthorize.

> Free ABA authorization tracker: paste your authorizations and see which units run out early, which expire unused, and when each reauthorization is due. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/aba-authorization-tracker/)
